We aim to estimate the circumstellar abundances of SiO, SiS, and their most abundant isotopologues ($^{29}$SiO, $^{30}$SiO, $^{29}$SiS, $^{30}$SiS, and Si$^{34}$S) for a sample of five carbon stars.
This study compares molecular abundances across the sources, tests chemical modelling predictions, and examines whether IRC$+$10$\,$216 is representative of the broader carbon star population.
